import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/actors/csv-preflight')
inputs = ('src/__init__.py', 'src/core.py', 'tests/run_tests.py')
command = [sys.executable, '-m', 'tests.run_tests']
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
if result.returncode and 'No module named' in result.stderr:
    command = [sys.executable, 'tests/run_tests.py']
    import os
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': '.'}, capture_output=True, text=True)
record = {
    'scope': 'Offline CSV core baseline using existing fixtures. Grant eligibility, buyer demand and settlement are unverified.',
    'cwd': str(root),
    'command': command,
    'python_version': sys.version.split()[0],
    'input_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in inputs},
    'exit_code': result.returncode,
    'stdout': result.stdout,
    'stderr': result.stderr,
}
output = Path('products/services/nlnet-open-call-fit/csv-core-baseline.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
